description: Opus 5.5 fair fight: Opus built its own predictor in a sandbox; scored on the 300 val routes
metric: official rc-cli score, lower is better, 0 = driver's exact order; invalid routes get the challenge's invalid-sequence score
shortest_source: results/v0_shortest_val.json (run_plain_baseline settings: OR-Tools PATH_CHEAPEST_ARC + GUIDED_LOCAL_SEARCH, 10 s per route, 3 workers); saved tours re-scored here with the official scorer, all 300 per-route scores matched exactly
